name: protocol-auditors
description: Domain auditors for cryptographic protocols: DKG/threshold signatures (FROST, MuSig2), MPC (garbled circuits, OT), threshold ECDSA (GG18/GG20/CGGMP21, Paillier/MtA), shielded-pool privacy protocols (nullifiers, note commitments, replay domains), and VDFs (Wesolowski, Pietrzak).
